title: Databases with repeated backup failures
description: Consider only backups with status = failed. For each database_name, count failed_count and keep databases with at least 2 failures. Return exactly two columns: database_name, failed_count. Sort by failed_count DESC, then database_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT database_name, COUNT(*) AS failed_count
FROM backups
hints: Apply the group count threshold through HAVING.
solution_explanation: WHERE removes successful backups before aggregation and HAVING keeps repeated failures only.
